QuestInfo.name: [Erel Light] The Reunion
QuestInfo.1: You couldn't accept #p9201713#'s decision.\n#p9201715#'s intervention prevented you from reaching him, but there were sparkling orbs of light left behind when he vanished.
QuestInfo.2: You destroyed the sparkling spheres of light, bringing all of Helia's people back. Well, almost all of them.
